title: Gitmap symbol record (one line of symbols.ndjson)

id.description: Stable id: sym_<slug(canonical code)>, with _vN suffix for duplicate codes. Code-derived, so the same symbol from OCD/OMap gets the same id.

code.description: Canonical symbol code (canonicalSymbolCode: OCAD '101.0' collapses to '101'; '204.1.0' preserved).

type.description: Canonical symbol kind. An area+border idiom is 'combined'.

rotatable.description: Symbol rotates with its object. Present only when true.

layers.description: Source-independent draw layers, in paint order. Colour references are stable color_… ids. Lengths in map units; angles in degrees. Text typography is authoritative in the `text` layer's nested `text` object (there is no top-level symbol fontSize).

renderLayer.description: A tagged draw layer. `type` selects the shape; the other fields are documented below. Enum-like fields (`capStyle`, `joinStyle`) are semantic strings, colour references are `colorId`, and geometry is `coordinates` — matching the object records. The field NAMES here are frozen for v1. Canonical output has one shape per concept: OCAD's double-line / structure-fill / border-symbol and xmap's nested line symbols are all canonicalised to the types in the `type` enum, so those input dialects never appear in output. A residual cross-format difference remains only at the element-content level for some decorations (genuine source/format loss, see the README's Known gaps), so this stays permissive: opaque nested format-native structures (the `pattern` record, nested `element.symbol` trees) are allowed and keep their source-format field names (`color`, `coords`, `innerColor`, …).

colorId.description: Stable color_… id. -1 / absent means a no-ink layer.

pattern.description: point-pattern-fill: xmap-native pattern record (angle, lineSpacing, pointDistance, symbol tree, …). Opaque.

text.description: text layer: authoritative typography sub-object (font family/size live here, not on the layer or symbol).

element.description: An OCAD-style icon primitive (line/area/circle/dot). `colorId` is a stable id.

type.description: OCAD element kind (an opaque source-format primitive code).

coordinates.description: Icon-primitive geometry as coord tuples, the same shape and field name as object `coordinates`: [x, y] or [x, y, flags]. Symbol-internal (y-up). An icon area primitive isn't ring-split, so `hole` stays a valid flag here.
